A **Snapshot** post contains a few charts and some basic analysis, and can be read in under five minutes; a **Deep dive** contains many charts and more-detailed analysis, and takes a lot more than five minutes to read. Use the **Categories** list (beside the posts on a desktop, below them on a phone) to filter by post type or topic.
